data.long_meaning: Parinita is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘parinati’, which means ‘beginning’, ‘start’, or ‘origin’. This name is often used in Hindu mythology to describe the first step or initiation of a spiritual journey. The name Parinita carries the meaning “Beginning, Start, Origin” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Parinita usually hope their child will grow to embody beginning, start, origin and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parinita total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
